sourceVerification.leaderModel: two endpoints plus one strict interior position; EACH selected breed occurs exactly once in the ENTIRE delegation, including nonleaders

points: For fixed endpoints, their unique breeds cannot appear inside; therefore every internal singleton supplies exactly one possible third leader. Query restricts left>p to make the new right breed unique.
Before insertion, a_l tests uniqueness in[l,r) and w_l counts singleton breeds in[l+1,r). Query[p+1,r) must precede every insertion update.
Previous two equal positions q
Only p changes from active to inactive, permanently. Deactivation before range updates is safe because its weight is no longer used. New r is activated with zero after all updates.
Tree range delta changes sum by int64(delta)*activeCount. Push precedes a membership change, and replacing a leaf resets count/sum/lazy, so new activation inherits no historical tag.
At leaves, replace returns before push. Integer half-open queries are either fully covering or disjoint at a leaf, so add/fold do not push nonexistent children.
Signed int64 labels use only sorting/equality/lower_bound, with no subtraction, absolute value, unsigned sentinel or arithmetic on extreme labels.
N is checked before narrowing or allocation. 4N<=800000 node slots; count<=N; |lazy|<=2N; widened product<=8e10 and answer<=1333313333400000 fit int64.
O(Nlog(N+1)) time/O(N) auxiliary memory, logarithmic tree recursion. All caller-visible state is local; empty/short inputs and repeated calls satisfy the documented API.

additionalIndependentProbe.allEqualityPatterns: All restricted-growth strings length0..10, representing every possible equality partition, including five or more distinct labels beyond the author four-label exhaustive domain.
additionalIndependentProbe.tripleOracle: Compute nearest equal before/after for each position by direct pairwise scans. Enumerate every l<m<r; require next[l]>r, prev[r]<l, prev[m]<l and next[m]>r. Crosscheck this predicate against direct full-interval equality counts on every pattern N<=7. No active/lazy/previous-two update recurrence is used.
additionalIndependentProbe.concatenationIdentity: For disjoint label alphabets, F(A+B)=F(A)+F(B)+WA*CB+CA*WB. CA/WA are count and sum of interior-singleton weights for left endpoints unique in their A suffix; CB/WB analogously use right endpoints unique in their B prefix. Separate frequency-map scans compute these statistics. Cross intervals choose independent valid endpoints and the third leader from either block, proving the identity.
additionalIndependentProbe.maximumScope: Eight distinct N=200000 concatenations of length100000 blocks, combining unique/random label patterns, int64 minimum/maximum sentinels as actual labels and repeated breeds;1000 additional random concatenations.

permanentProbe.normalization: Only article destination and removal of implicit /tmp result writes. Algorithm and assertions unchanged.
